import re

HEADER = re.compile(r"^(?P<offset>[0-9A-F]+) (?P<record>[A-Z0-9 ]*?(?:HEADER|RECORD|LOCATOR|DESCRIPTOR|SIGNATURE)(?: #\d+)?)\s{2,}(?P<signature>[0-9A-F]{8})\s*$")
FIELD = re.compile(r"^(?:(?P<offset>[0-9A-F]+)(?P<pad> +)|(?P<nooff>\s+))(?P<field>\S(?:.*?\S)?)(?:\s{2,}(?P<rest>\S.*?))?\s*$")
REST = re.compile(r"^(?:(?P<value>[^']\S*)\s*)?(?:'(?P<decoded>.*)')?$")


def parse(lines):
    headers = {"name": "headers", "kind": "table", "lines": [], "records": []}
    fields = {"name": "fields", "kind": "table", "lines": [], "records": []}
    record = parent = ""
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = HEADER.match(ln)
        if m:
            record, parent = m.group("record"), ""
            headers["lines"].append(i)
            headers["records"].append({"record": record, "offset": m.group("offset"),
                                       "signature": m.group("signature")})
            continue
        m = FIELD.match(ln)
        if not m:
            continue
        indented = m.group("nooff") is not None or len(m.group("pad")) > 1
        if not indented:
            parent = m.group("field")
        rest = m.group("rest") or ""
        r = REST.match(rest)
        value, decoded = (r.group("value") or "", r.group("decoded") or "") if r else (rest, "")
        fields["lines"].append(i)
        fields["records"].append({"record": record, "parent": parent if indented else "",
                                  "offset": m.group("offset") or "", "field": m.group("field"),
                                  "value": value, "decoded": decoded})
    return [headers, fields]
